newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Oats Co Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Oats Co Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1995 net loss after $40.8 million restructuring charge. Q4 1995 operating loss before charge $0.18 a share.
Year-ago Q4 sales include $90.3 million from divested businesses. Excluding divested businesses, sales declined three percent.
Q4 1996 net income is before $800,000 in preferred dividends vs $1.0 million.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Full-year 1995 sales include $796.9 million from divested businesses. Excluding divested businesses, sales were down one percent.
Full-year 1996 net income is before $3.7 million in preferred dividends vs $4.0 million.
Full-year 1996 results include $113.4 million gain vs $1.05 billion gain.
Excluding gains and restructuring charges in both years, full-year operating profit was $1.34 a share vs $0.72.
